title.narrative: Technical Support for Umoja Analytics Enhancements and Production Support Services for United Nations Office of Information and Communications Technology (OICT)

description.narrative: The United Nations Office of Information and Communications Technology (OICT) enables a better, safer, more sustainable future through innovative technology. The UN Secretariat engaged UNOPS to implement projects and deliver services in support of the delivery of its mandates. The Enterprise Solutions Service of OICT (ESS) coordinates the governance of enterprise and specialized ICT systems and solutions, as well as the agile development of applications in response to client requirements at the local, regional, departmental or enterprise levels, considering the needs and priorities of the Organization and unique local requirements and Enterprise Solutions to ensure that investments in solutions are transparent and prioritized accordingly.\n
